title: RISE Live: the Astronomy collection hung in the room, with its credit
acceptance: @scene <id> astronomy is read, admitted and lowered to { kind: 'sourced', collections: ['sci-astronomy'] }; a parameter on it is refused; RISE chooses the work from the reviewed collection.

In the venue a collection image is hung in the full frame's safe rectangle in every room (at most square on a tall screen, at most 3:2 on a wide one), never full-bleed and never in the inner eye or the shell; the gallery is placed there unscaled, matted in black.
The chip shows the title before the credit and licence; at 1440x900 and 390x844 its box lies inside the picture's box and meets neither the words, the ask bar, the docked face nor the sign-in link.
About this reading lists each picture the reading showed, once, with title, full credit, licence and source link.
'astronomy' and 'show me astronomy' are answered by the venue at once with no model call; the bar's note goes once the picture is hung and the room is at rest on it.
Composer's guide does not offer the collection until the card can show it; the first-load budget and the security policy are unchanged.
Human gate: the owner watches a real model's reading that uses the collection on the deployed /live, in the dark room and the light room.
